messages.subject: When the commercial version of shiny-server come out?
parts:
Hi, 
  I am working on a shiny-server project which need to set the user names and passwords for different users, so we need the log in module. I heard it will be included in a commercial version, but when the commercial version come out?

Regards!

messages.author: 9711d30301c32133
messages.subject: Re: When the commercial version of shiny-server come out?
parts:
Hi Huidong,

We're currently in a closed Beta, but hope to release the commercial product very soon. We will include authentication in Shiny Server Pro, along with a variety of other features.

We'll also be opening up the Beta to more participants shortly, so check our website (http://rstudio.com/shiny/) later this week and we should have information about registering for the beta.

Best,
Jeff

messages.subject: Re: When the commercial version of shiny-server come out?
parts:
JinRou,

It is indeed different. Shiny Server Pro is a platform that you can run on your own servers to host Shiny applications.

The hosted ShinyApps alpha we'll run on our servers (though we happen to be running Shiny Server Pro to host your apps).

Two different entities, two different pricing schemes, you can pick one or the other (or both!).

Jeff
